sandbox: fresh API service; send a known forwarded client address, inspect SQLite, and assert only its SHA-256 hash is stored

sandbox: fresh temporary working directory with /data absent; launch the compiled service twice with only PATH and PORT and verify health, SQLite creation, and generated-secret reuse
